'''Xanif''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who worked at [[Maya Armus]], a spa owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Azzim Anjiliac Atirue]] located at [[Napdu]], the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Da Soocha]]. Before its [[Devastation of Da Soocha|destruction]] at the behest of [[Darth Azard]], Azzim ordered Xanif to transmit a recording of Azard's [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] transmission to Azzim's uncle, [[Vedo Anjiliac Atirue|Vedo]]. As his last command, Azzim told Xanif to escape from Napdu if she can.<ref name="legacy48" />
